observed_value: issuer_name stored as concatenated dimension and terms text, e.g. '1st Lien/Secured Loans Canada 1261229 BC LTD Instrument 1st Lien Term Loan Industry Healthcare Equipment & Supplies Rate S+6.25% Interest Rate 9.92% Original Acquisition Date 8/28/2025 Maturity Date 10/8/2030'
anchor_value: Raw source separates Portfolio Company '1261229 BC LTD' from Instrument, Industry, Rate, Interest Rate, Original Acquisition Date, Maturity Date, Par Amount, Cost, and Fair Value columns.

findings.detail: issuer_name includes wrapper path and separate row terms; the source issuer cell is only 1261229 BC LTD while instrument, industry, rates, dates, cost, and fair value are separate columns.

rationale: C206 is a real issuer_name parse leak. The raw SOI row has a clean Portfolio Company cell and separate columns for instrument, industry, rate, interest rate, dates, par, cost, fair value, and net-asset percentage, but the extracted issuer_name concatenates country/category wrappers plus those separate terms into the issuer field.
